narr: On June 22nd, an initial round of thunderstorms produced localized flash flooding in Fayette County. A secondary round of storms moved through northeast Iowa during the afternoon, producing localized flooding and wind damage in Allamakee County.
ev: Trained spotters reported flash flooding from near Hawkeye to West Union with numerous roads under water.
Emergency management reported mudslides along Highway 26 outside of Lansing.
